deductions.title: A Warm Stone
deductions.text: Sample #14 was warm inside a -23 °C shadow. Something underneath is giving off heat.

deductions.title: It Keeps Time
deductions.text: Night 12 and Night 13 share the same 11.2-minute rhythm. Thermal creep doesn't keep time.

effects.text: Ruth will want to see this.

deductions.title: Two Channels, One Source
deductions.text: The ground shakes and the radio hums on the same 11.2-minute beat. One source.

deductions.title: Something Is Transmitting
deductions.text: A structured pulse — 3-1-4 — from 40 m beneath Site Alpha. Not a fault. A signal.

deductions.title: They Knew
deductions.text: HQ called it a fault before anybody filed a fault report. Someone was expecting this.

deductions.title: Older Than Us
deductions.text: The agency was chartered in 1969. Its own plaque on the Moon says 1958.

deductions.title: The Source
deductions.text: The probe sits right above the pulse. It was never buried deep — it was waiting.
